description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见[如何保证幂等性](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html)。
description.en: Ensures request idempotence. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter to differentiate between requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and must not exceed 64 characters. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html).

description.zh: 待添加标签的数据库文件系统实例列表。
description.en: A list of DBFS instances to which you want to add tags.

description.zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. Call [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

description.zh:
待添加的标签列表。

TagKey：资源的标签键。取值范围：最大长度为64个字符，可包含英文大小写字母、中文、数字和特殊符号@_-=+;:,<.>/?

 TagValue：资源的标签值。取值范围：最大长度为128个字符，可包含英文大小写字母、中文、数字和特殊符号@_-=+;:,<.>/?
description.en:
A list of tags to add.

TagKey: The tag key for the resource. Maximum length is 64 characters. Valid characters include uppercase and lowercase English letters, Chinese characters, digits, and the special symbols @ \_ - = + ; : , < . > / ?

TagValue: The tag value for the resource. Maximum length is 128 characters. Valid characters include uppercase and lowercase English letters, Chinese characters, digits, and the special symbols @ \_ - = + ; : , < . > / ?
